audioText: Welcome to Class 3, Grade 4! We have simple class rules. First, arrive at school before 8:00 and read quietly. Second, listen carefully in class and raise your hand to speak. Third, keep our classroom clean and never run in the hallway. Good rules help everyone learn happily.
